dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline curvature along the trailing edge, exhibiting a pronounced backward-curving sickle shape from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological point with a significant pixel radius, classified as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin oriented at approximately a 35 to 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The dorsal fin exhibits a base-to-height ratio where the horizontal pixel width at the base is greater than the vertical height from base to apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, distinct notch is visible on the lower half of the trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular highlights clustered along the visible mid-to-lower flank region.
